metadata.title: FlavorWheel Styling & Layout Systematization Context
metadata.purpose: Comprehensive context for resolving styling inconsistencies and layout issues across the entire FlavorWheel application
metadata.scope: Complete audit and resolution of React errors, mobile navigation visibility, design system consistency, and layout standardization
metadata.severity: HIGH - Multiple critical issues affecting user experience and functionality
metadata.analysis_framework: Multi-layered approach covering technical fixes, design system alignment, and user experience optimization

react_import_errors.description: React not defined errors in multiple files

mobile_navigation_visibility.description: Mobile navigation not always visible on certain pages
mobile_navigation_visibility.root_cause: Inconsistent application of navigation visibility rules
mobile_navigation_visibility.current_logic: Based on pathname pattern matching in navigation-visibility.ts
mobile_navigation_visibility.impact: Poor mobile user experience and navigation confusion

design_system_inconsistencies.description: Inconsistent styling patterns across pages and components
issues: Mixed usage of fx- design tokens vs legacy classes
Inconsistent background gradients and color schemes
design_system_inconsistencies.impact: Visual inconsistency and poor brand coherence

layout_standardization.description: Different layout patterns and container structures
issues: Inconsistent use of AppShell vs direct layouts
Mixed container max-widths and padding approaches
layout_standardization.impact: Inconsistent user experience and maintenance overhead

component_styling_conflicts.description: Conflicts between component-specific styles and global design system
issues: Override of design system tokens by component styles
Inconsistent use of CSS custom properties
Conflicts between Tailwind and custom CSS

fx_design_tokens.recommendation: Standardize on fx- tokens across all components

tailwind_integration.issues: Inconsistent use of custom spacing and color tokens
tailwind_integration.recommendation: Ensure all components use design system tokens

locale_layout.structure: Simple wrapper div with locale-layout class
locale_layout.issues: No real layout functionality, just a wrapper
locale_layout.recommendation: Either enhance or remove this layout layer

page_specific_layouts.dashboard_pages: AppShell with navigation and content areas
page_specific_layouts.landing_pages: Full-screen hero sections with custom layouts
page_specific_layouts.inconsistency: Different approaches to responsive design and spacing

card_components.issues: Inconsistent border radius, shadows, and background usage

button_components.recommendation: Standardize button variants using design tokens

form_components.issues: Inconsistent focus states and error handling

current_implementation.logic: Pattern-based pathname matching with show/hide rules

issues_identified: Inconsistent pathname cleaning for locale prefixes
Missing rules for new pages added recently
No fallback handling for edge cases

files: All component files using React hooks
tasks.action: Add missing React imports where needed
Improve pathname handling and add missing rules
Replace legacy classes with fx- design tokens
Implement consistent max-widths and padding patterns
Create standardized Card variants with consistent styling
Implement consistent button variants and states
Ensure consistent breakpoint usage across components
Ensure all interactive elements meet 44px minimum

tasks.task: Audit and clean CSS custom properties
tasks.action: Remove unused tokens and standardize naming
Ensure all design tokens are properly integrated
Set up ESLint rules for design system compliance

responsive_strategy.breakpoints: Use Tailwind defaults: sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl
responsive_strategy.mobile_first: Design mobile-first, enhance for larger screens

technical: Zero React import errors across all components
All components use design system tokens
user_experience: Consistent visual design across all pages
Reliable mobile navigation on all pages
Smooth responsive behavior on all devices
maintainability: Easy to extend and modify components

breaking_changes.risk: Layout changes could break existing functionality

performance_impact.risk: Additional CSS and components could impact bundle size
performance_impact.mitigation: Use dynamic imports and code splitting appropriately

cross_browser_compatibility.risk: Design token usage might not work across all browsers
